subject: Value of K in pcountOpen: R crashes

messages.author: c05fcdc4ef96c903
messages.subject: Value of K in pcountOpen: R crashes
parts:
Hi,

I am analyzing my point count bird data. And I am trying to estimate their abundance using pcountOpen. I had already done this, but then had to include few more covariates so I am redoing it. The maximum count that have ever reached is 101. So the code was working fine for K=250. Now everything is same, but it won't start analyzing for any K<800. Even at K=800, it runs for 45 minutes and then R crashes.

Below is my code and any suggestion will be really appreciated.

est_500<-read.csv("abun_500_all_crp.csv")

#observation covarites for detection

obs.covs_500 <- list(
 
  dates_survey = matrix(c(
    est_500$date_14,
    est_500$date_15,
    est_500$date_16,
    est_500$date_17,
    est_500$date_18), nrow=110, ncol=5, byrow=TRUE))

#yearly covarites for survival
year.covs_500<-list(
  year_survey= matrix(c(
   
    est_500$Year4,
    est_500$Year5,
    est_500$Year6,
    est_500$Year7,
    est_500$Year8), nrow=110, ncol=5, byrow=TRUE),
 
  pp_survey = matrix(c(
   
    est_500$pp_14,
    est_500$pp_15,
    est_500$pp_16,
    est_500$pp_17,
    est_500$pp_18), nrow=110, ncol=5, byrow=TRUE),
 
  max_survey = matrix(c(
   
    est_500$max_14,
    est_500$max_15,
    est_500$max_16,
    est_500$max_17,
    est_500$max_18), nrow=110, ncol=5, byrow=TRUE),
 
  min_survey = matrix(c(
   
    est_500$min_14,
    est_500$min_15,
    est_500$min_16,
    est_500$min_17,
    est_500$min_18), nrow=110, ncol=5, byrow=TRUE) 
 
 
)
#unmarked frame
estabun_open_500<-unmarkedFramePCO( y = est_500[,5:9],
                                    siteCovs = est_500[,62:142],
                                     yearlySiteCovs= year.covs_500,
                                    obsCovs = obs.covs_500,
                                    numPrimary = 5
                                   
)

siteCovs(estabun_open_500) <- scale(siteCovs(estabun_open_500))
yearlySiteCovs(estabun_open_500) <- scale(yearlySiteCovs(estabun_open_500))
obsCovs(estabun_open_500) <- scale(obsCovs(estabun_open_500))

#constant model
m1_500 <- pcountOpen(~1, ~1, ~1, ~1, estabun_open_500,K=800, dynamics = "trend",mixture = "P") R crashes after 45-50 minutes

Can some one please tell what am I doing wrong. This code was working fine for K=250. Now R just crashes at K=800. And I don't get why I need to have K=800 in first place when my maximum observation is 101.

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: Value of K in pcountOpen: R crashes
parts:
Can you be more specific about "but it won't start analyzing for any K<800"? Nothing happens? Or you can get an error message and if so what is it?

I would double check to make sure that your y matrix didn't get messed up somehow between the working run and this one. For example check the output of 

max(estabun_open_500@y, na.rm=TRUE)

and make sure it's 101 as you expect.
